newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed, futures weigh on index.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed, futures weigh on index.

text.p: UK's leading blue chip shares opened mixed to lower on Monday as investors marked time ahead of this week's UK monetary meeting.
The benchmark FTSE 100 share index was down 10.2 points to 4,889.1 at 0737 GMT as a weak start in the futures market undermined the market. FTSE 100 decliners outpaced advancers 56 to 25.
Gilts slid in early trading. And sterling slipped, though remained well above the 3.0 deutsche market level ahead of the Bank of England's policy-setting meeting on August 6-7.
